assumptions: Intending to submit via XML is the stated trigger, which can arise before an actual filing.

citations.quote: licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format
licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)

children.distinction: Determines whether the XML-specific duties are triggered for the assessed firm; it does not determine performance of those duties.

facts.meaning: The assessed entity is a licensed corporation, SFC-licensed virtual asset service provider or associated entity within the circular’s definition of licensed firms.
facts.name: is_licensed_firm
facts.unit: Boolean classification of the assessed entity

facts.meaning: At the assessment time, the assessed entity intends to submit STRs via XML in connection with the STREAMS 2 transition; an actual submission is not required for this fact.
facts.name: intends_xml_submission
facts.unit: Boolean intention of the assessed entity at the assessment time

children.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The trigger for the XML-specific duties is satisfied when the assessed entity is a licensed firm intending to submit STRs via XML, including before an actual filing.
children.subject: Firm-level trigger for XML-specific duties

assumptions: Intending to submit via XML is the stated trigger, which can arise before an actual filing.
Arranging a technical test is distinct from proving that a test has passed.

citations.quote: licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.

children.distinction: Choosing XML does not exhaust XML-specific duties. Schema conformity and prompt liaison are mandatory. The cited text does not expressly make successful test completion a filing prerequisite. The supplied JFIU announcement repeats the separate-schema and liaison requirements but supplies neither the schema nor a timing test or test-passing prerequisite.
questions: How is as soon as possible assessed, and does separate guidance impose a test-passing prerequisite?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] A licensed firm intending to submit XML STRs must follow the separately provided JFIU schema and liaise with the JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. Missing schema contents and the contextual timing standard prevent a complete executable determination here.
children.subject: Schema conformity and timely technical-test liaison

obligations.explanation: The actor, intention trigger, mandatory duties and timing standard are retained. Only the trigger is executable; the complete compliance determination remains unresolved.
Intention remains the trigger and may precede an actual filing.
Arranging a test remains distinct from passing it; no successful-test prerequisite is inferred.
The question is retained verbatim. The supplied authorities do not identify the applicable schema version or provide its contents.
The compound question is retained verbatim. Neither the contextual timing assessment nor any separate test-passing prerequisite is resolved by the supplied authorities.

value.parent_relation: For the same assessed firm and assessment time, reading_4_trigger identifies when the parent’s duties apply. When that trigger is satisfied, the parent requires both schema conformity and liaison as soon as possible to arrange a technical test, as retained together in reading_4_performance. Trigger satisfaction is not parent compliance. The decomposition preserves the parent’s meaning but supplies no executable parent result while performance remains unformalized; it adds neither an actual-filing trigger nor a test-passing prerequisite.
